Our Priority

Happy and Healthy Horses

Happy and healthy horses have been the number one priority for Megan and Rene Lizarraga ever since the founding of Taft Hill Acres in 2012. A spacious, yet comfortable 10 acre boarding facility - Taft Hill Acres is located 10 minutes north-west of the C.S.U. campus.

The comfort and convenience for our human friends is just as important to us at Taft Hill Acres. Clients can relax knowing our facility has locked gates on both ends of property, video cameras at entrance, heated indoor restroom, and locking tack rooms. We have several trainers available but are open to outside trainers with pre-approval from management. Owners and manager live on site.
